collection.title: Lotus Elise 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Lotus Elise 2011 Onwards S3 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
